title: Extend processing compatibility persistence

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Processing persistence tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_processing_persistence.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#compatibility-identity plus #face_momentphoto_pipeline_states, #face_momentphoto_faces and #face_momentprocessing_runtime_status RED: the current 0007 head lacks the required compatibility fields, terminal/publication columns, face rows and runtime singleton; GREEN: one direct linear revision aborts unchanged for any legacy revision row and, from an empty revision table, adds the exact constraints through upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade while preserving unrelated prerequisite rows; decisive comparison: precondition failure leaves schema/data unchanged and empty-path introspection, ancestry and retained-row assertions match all four locators; artifact: isolated migration transcript and database projections.
purpose: Provide the complete processing-owned relational shape required by later FT-002 behavior through one compatible linear migration.
success_outcome: The migration fails unchanged when a legacy revision exists and otherwise exposes immutable compatibility metadata, complete processing state, Photo faces and the narrow runtime-status singleton through the linear schema stream.
anti_goals: Do not implement claiming, inference, derivatives, API behavior or another migration stream.
Do not fabricate legacy compatibility metadata, delete/repoint references, or add jobs, history, leases, per-slice schemas or cross-owner delete cascades.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The required shape cannot be added through one direct linear revision without changing the accepted database topology.
Any foreign-owner cascade or mutable compatibility identity would be required.
A non-empty legacy revision table must be migrated rather than reset; stop instead of inventing backfill values or mutating its references.

constraints: Extend the linear Alembic head current at execution; do not assert a mutable future exact head.
Keep every processing model under the processing owner and the shared Base/MetaData.
Use one migration for the accepted compatibility/state/face/runtime persistence shape.
Before its first schema mutation, assert pipeline_revisions is empty and abort unchanged when any row exists.
invariants: Pipeline compatibility identity is immutable once referenced.
No legacy compatibility value is synthesized and no revision reference is deleted or repointed.
Photo faces are revision-specific and embedding dimension matches the revision.
Database cascades never cross ownership boundaries.
verification_targets: A non-empty legacy revision fixture, including a referenced row, aborts before mutation with identical schema and data.
An empty-revision upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade preserves unrelated prerequisite rows while adding every exact constraint and index.
Direct down_revision, upgrade, downgrade and re-upgrade remain linear and leave one Alembic head.
